snippet.title: GODBREAKERS | OFFICIAL ACTION TRAILER💥 The Mix Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Revealed in The MIX Fall Showcase 2025, this Official Action Trailer offers an exclusive look at Godbreakers gameplay that has never been revealed before! Play the Demo & Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687400/GODBREAKERS/

Enjoy co-op action, boss fights, fluid combat, and 'Godbreaking': which lets the player absorb enemy powers & use them against their masters💥 This action trailer provides a sneak peek at some of the perilous biomes with deadly enemies and bosses waiting to be challenged! Diving straight into thrilling gameplay - Godbreakers is coming in 2025 to PlayStation 5, Steam & the Epic Games Store.

Wishlist Godbreakers Now:
Steam: https://brnw.ch/godbreakerssteam
Playstation 5: https://brnw.ch/godbreakerps
